slot_scores.name: no_borrowing_cash_only
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there any limit on the total amount you can invest across all products in a single year, or is the only constraint the per-product caps and the available cash at the beginning of that year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched on available cash as a constraint but did not explicitly ask whether borrowing is allowed or whether only cash on hand can be used.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No borrowing is allowed; investments are limited to available cash on hand.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly confirmed whether borrowing was permitted, yet the READY_TO_MODEL summary assumes cash-flow balance with no borrowing.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about borrowing/cash-only was not fully resolved.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarifying questions but only partially addressed the no-borrowing/cash-only constraint and then stopped with that P1 issue unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
